title: Brief intake: requirements, deliverables and facts
story: As the engagement lead I need the interview brief decomposed into traceable requirements, deliverables and a single facts file so nothing in the specification is missed
acceptance: brief/interview-brief.txt is the full text of the PDF
Every instruction, consideration, persona detail and logistics item in the brief maps to at least one REQ in brief/requirements.json, each with deliverables and a verification method
brief/facts.json reproduces the brief's FinTechCo facts exactly (team sizes, stacks, infrastructure, priorities, attendees, meeting timings) and marks placeholders

verdicts.reason: Brief txt identical to pdftotext of PDF; all 30 REQs have deliverables+verify; every brief instruction/consideration/persona/logistics item maps to a REQ; facts.json exact; nits: REQ-09 'minute 35' vs ADR-005 0:37, minor unmapped scenario color
